Purpose

Mission, vision and direction

  1. 01

    Our Mission

    Our mission is to ensure unparalleled customer satisfaction through the delivery of high-quality services, value-added solutions, and prompt service delivery. We are committed to providing innovative solutions tailored to meet our customers' technical needs, while maintaining a steadfast focus on safety.

  2. 02

    Our Vision

    Our vision is to excel in understanding our customers' technical requirements and providing straightforward solutions. We prioritize constant communication and support, striving to be the industry leader in electrical substation protection and automation systems. Our unwavering commitment to safety underscores every aspect of our operations.

  3. 03

    Leading the Way

    We strive to set the benchmark in the way we electrify, automate, and digitalize the world around us. Through innovative solutions and unwavering commitment, we aim to exceed industry standards and deliver unmatched value to our customers.

See our customers

Technical capability at a glance

Voltage range
Control & relay panels, HT/LT switchgear, substation equipment and SAS products from 400 V to 765 kV
Substations
Primary and secondary equipment in AIS & GIS substations up to 765 kV
SAS voltage levels
11 kV, 33 kV, 132 kV, 220 kV, 440 kV, 765 kV
Communication protocols
IEC 61850 Ed1 & Ed2, DNP3.0, MODBUS, IEC 101, 103, 104 & Courier
Relay makes
ABB/Hitachi, GE/Alstom, SIEMENS, Schneider Electric, SEL, NR Electric, Toshiba, L&T, Easun Reyrolle, Ashida, Avana, JVS, Megawin & every make
Engineering software
ETAP (E-TAP) for relay coordination, load flow and power system analysis studies; Electrical CAD for scheme drawings
